title: Barking Shopfronts
description: bsfgroup.co.uk Barkingshopfronts Limited is a London-based shop front manufacturer and installer founded in 2018 in Barking, specializing in aluminium, frameless glass and timber shop fronts, roller shutters, canopies and structural steel for retail, restaurants and offices. With around 20 to 30 staff and estimated revenue of 1 to 5 million pounds, it runs its own production facility on Movers Lane in East London. Its unique Sit-and-Go Shops product offers fully fitted ready-to-open retail spaces from frontage to interior fixtures. The company has delivered projects across all London boroughs including a flagship aluminium frontage for a Mayfair espresso bar and international work in Romania. Services span design, manufacturing, installation and maintenance of shop fronts, bi-fold doors, automatic doors, fire exits and security shutters. Key strengths are in-house production, full-spectrum frontage solutions and the innovative turnkey shop concept.
